name: herdr-interactive-tool-block
description: Reports the Herdr pane as blocked while a rule says the agent is waiting on the user mid-execution. Modular rules cover browser-tools interactive calls, difit reviews, and Plannotator reviews.

enabled.description: Flip the Herdr pane to blocked while a rule reports the agent is waiting on the user

rules.description: Per-rule enablement. Set a rule id to false to disable it.

browserToolsOps.description: Interactive browser-tools op names for the browser-tools rule; a matching call is treated as blocking mid-execution
